# Component Index

<!-- Generated by Secomm Production AI Toolkit (Phase 1c). Nằm tại: .ai/project/COMPONENT_INDEX.md -->
<!-- DURABLE project scope map (RM-08). Stable `CMP-*` IDs là join key cho canonical records (FEAT/BUG/DEC `components:`). -->
<!-- `bin/project-ai-validate --check-project-state` verify: mọi record `components:` resolve tới một row dưới đây. -->
<!-- Project-owned — never overwritten by toolkit sync. -->

The **component index** is the durable scope map: one row per component, with its capability, source areas, and the records/decisions that affect it. It is how a Developer/TL/AI answers "what owns this, where is it, what touches it" **without a whole-project audit**.

## Schema (one row per component)

| Component ID | Capability | Current status | Mapped source areas | Related feature/bug records | Related decisions | Owner | Last verified commit | Last verified date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CMP-{NAME} | {what this component does} | current \| suspect \| stale | {file/dir roots} | FEAT-XXX; BUG-XXX | DEC-XXX | {team/role, optional} | {sha} | {YYYY-MM-DD} |

## Rules (RM-08)

- **Stable IDs.** A `CMP-*` ID does not change when files move. A renamed/merged component either **keeps its ID** or records `supersedes`/`superseded_by` (like decision records) so links never dangle.
- **Join key.** Every `components:` entry in a FEAT/BUG/DEC record MUST resolve to a row here. `--check-project-state` fails on a dangling `CMP-*` reference.
- **Status drives re-audit scope.** `current` = credible (trust, don't re-audit); `suspect`/`stale` = trigger a **scoped** re-audit of only that component's source areas (not the whole project).
- **Keep current.** When a record touching a component → Done, update that row (status, `last_verified_*`, related-record links) — see `shared-core/functions/update-project-state.md`.
